summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 (event date October 5) reporting routine daily disclosures furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange under its existing stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate purchases of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce the ASX daily buy-back notices; no new authorization, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The filing keeps the market current on buy-back pace and remaining capacity; the risk-arb angle is simply monitoring repurchase execution against the $1 billion authorization and its support for per-share value.
